sn8.8:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Park, together with a great Saṅgha of bhikkhus, with , bhikkhus.
sn8.8:1.2: Now on that occasion the Blessed One was instructing, exhorting, inspiring, and gladdening the bhikkhus with a Dhamma talk concerning Nibbāna.
sn8.8:1.3: And those bhikkhus were listening to the Dhamma with eager ears, attending to it as a matter of vital concern, directing their whole mind to it.
sn8.8:1.4: Then it occurred to the Venerable Vaṅgīsa:
sn8.8:1.5: This Blessed One is instructing the bhikkhus with a Dhamma talk concerning Nibbāna.
sn8.8:1.6: And those bhikkhus are listening to the Dhamma with eager ears…”
sn8.8:1.7: Let me extol the Blessed One to his face with suitable verses.”
sn8.8:2.1: Then the Venerable Vaṅgīsa rose from his seat, arranged his upper robe over one shoulder, and, raising his joined hands in reverential salutation towards the Blessed One, said to him:
sn8.8:2.2: An inspiration has come to me, Blessed One! An inspiration has come to me, Fortunate One!
sn8.8:2.4: Then the Venerable Vaṅgīsa extolled the Blessed One to his face with  suitable verses
sn8.8:3.3: As he teaches the dust-free Dhamma,
sn8.8:4.2: Taught by the Perfectly Enlightened One.
sn8.8:5.2: The best seer of the seers.
sn8.8:5.3: Like a great cloud bearing rain
sn8.8:5.4: You pour down on the disciples.
sn8.8:6.2: From a desire to behold the Teacher,
sn8.8:6.3: Your disciple Vaṅgīsa, O great hero,
sn8.8:6.4: Bows down in worship at your feet.
sn8.8:7.1: “Had you already thought out these verses, Vaṅgīsa, or did they occur to you spontaneously?”
sn8.8:7.2: “I had not already thought out these verses, venerable sir; they occurred to me spontaneously.”
sn8.8:7.3: “In that case, Vaṅgīsa, let some more verses, not already thought out, occur to you.”
sn8.8:7.4: “Yes, venerable sir, ” the Venerable Vaṅgīsa replied. Then he extolled the Blessed One with some more verses that had not been previously thought out:
sn8.8:8.1: “Having overcome the deviant course of Māra’s path,
sn8.8:8.2: You fare having demolished barrenness of mind.
sn8.8:8.3: Behold him, the releaser from bondage,
sn8.8:9.1: “For the sake of leading us across the flood
sn8.8:9.2: You declared the path with its many aspects.
sn8.8:9.3: The seers of Dhamma stand immovable
sn8.8:9.4: In that Deathless declared by you.
sn8.8:10.2: Saw the transcendence of all stations;
sn8.8:10.3: Having known and realized it himself,
sn8.8:10.4: He taught the chief matter to the five.
sn8.8:11.1: “When the Dhamma has been so well taught,
sn8.8:11.2: What negligence is there for those who understand it?
sn8.8:11.3: Therefore, living diligent in the Blessed One’s Teaching,
sn8.8:11.4: One should always reverently train in it.
